remarks: This newly renovated home blends timeless charm with a cozy yet modern vibe, set on a beautiful, level half-acre in a sought-after neighborhood just minutes from the Cranbury Elementary School. From the moment you arrive, you'll feel right at home. Relax on the screened porch overlooking the peaceful property or gather by the wood-burning fireplace on cool evenings. The home offers flexible living with a primary bedroom option on either the first floor with a full bathroom or upstairs featuring a walk-in closet. Thoughtful updates throughout create a warm, inviting feel while providing today's comforts. Major improvements include a brand-new roof, new siding, and all new appliances-making this home truly move-in ready. Conveniently located near shopping at the Market and SoNo Mall, with easy access for commuting. The property features well water and public sewer. A rare combination of character, comfort, and convenience-this is a home you'll love coming back to.
